messages:
Cass (CSM): FYI Mariner procurement wants NET60 on PO, but they also asked for a vendor vetting form, SAP vendor code, and a split: 25% CC at signature, 75% PO NET60. They want no price change but prefer an 18mo term. Can we do this?
Ibrahim (AE): They're sticking to list price. Credit exposure looks high at 75% on NET60. Tagging Credit Ops and Billing.
Olga (Mariner): Hi all 94 procurement says their auditors require vendor vetting and PO-first for >50% spend. DocuSign ok as long as PO references the signed agreement. Can provide SAP vendor code in 24h.
Jules (Billing): 75% NET60 requires Credit Ops approval. Need vendor tax docs, remit-to, SAP vendor code, and PO sample. We also need CC webhook to capture the 25% upfront.
Procurement Bot: Note: "PO terms NET60 where >50% of ARR on PO -> Credit Ops & Legal approval required. Vendor vetting form must be completed before invoicing"
Credit Ops: For ARR bands under $300k, 75% NET60 will need exec credit exception. If they can move to 50/50 we can auto-approve. Otherwise we'll need a short cover memo + customer financials.
Cass (CSM): @Olga can you ask procurement if 50/50 is possible? Also please upload the vendor vetting form and SAP code.
Olga (Mariner): Procurement is strict about PO weighting. I'll ask if they can do 50/50 but no promises. SAP vendor code will be `MAR-SAP-512`. Vetting form to follow.
Legal Ops: We'll draft a 1-page services appendix with deliverables and acceptance criteria. If PO contains NET60, please paste Finance/Credit Ops approval on this thread before Billing invoices. Also recommend adding a short warranty clause for integration work.
Ibrahim (AE): Alternative: propose 18mo term + 10% prepayment (higher CC) to lower PO share. Would procurement accept an increased CC % instead of changing PO terms?
Olga (Mariner): I'll test that option. They might accept 35% upfront CC for audit reasons.
Jules (Billing): Proposed flow if 35/65: capture CC 35% -> issue invoice 65% with `PO: MAR-2026-081` NET60. Need SAP code on invoice header: `VendorCode: RWINF-67
SAPCode: MAR-SAP-512
TaxID: 44-5566778`
Credit Ops: If they can shift to 35% upfront we'll likely approve without exec. If not, prepare cover memo + CFO contact for exception.
Onboarding Eng: We'll prep kickoff docs but won't schedule live training until upfront CC clears. Integration sprint can start after initial payment.
Cass (CSM): Action items: (1) Olga to push procurement for 35-50% upfront and send vetting form + SAP code (2) Legal Ops to draft appendix + warranty clause (3) Jules to prepare invoice template & CC capture link (4) Credit Ops to advise on memo template if exec approval needed.
Olga (Mariner): Vetting form uploaded, SAP code confirmed. Procurement says 35% might work; they'll confirm by EOD tomorrow.
Legal Ops: Draft ready, sharing via DM. Will post once reviewed.
Jules (Billing): Payment link ready, invoice template prepped. Will hold until approval on thread.
Credit Ops: Noted. Standby for cover memo if procurement reverts to 25/75.
Cass (CSM): Thanks team. Please react with :white_check_mark: when each item is done. I'll update thread when procurement confirms upfront % or sends PO.
